mapper.insert: INSERT INTO log_error ( site_id, site_code, actor_user_id, actor_user_type, actor_login_id, request_uri, http_method, query_string, client_ip, user_agent, error_class, error_message, stack_trace, status_code, trace_id, session_id, logged_at, created_by, created_ip, created_at ) VALUES ( #{siteId}, #{siteCode}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserType}, #{actorLoginId}, #{requestUri}, #{httpMethod}, #{queryString}, #{clientIp}, #{userAgent}, #{errorClass}, #{errorMessage}, #{stackTrace}, #{statusCode}, #{traceId}, #{sessionId}, COALESCE(#{loggedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.sql:
WHERE logged_at >= #{search.dateFrom} AND logged_at < DATE_ADD(#{search.dateTo}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND ( error_class LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR error_message LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR request_uri LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR client_ip LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') OR actor_login_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{search.keyword}, '%') )
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM log_error
ORDER BY logged_at DESC LIMIT #{search.pageSize} OFFSET #{search.offset}
SELECT FROM log_error WHERE log_error_id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM log_error WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} ORDER BY logged_at ASC LIMIT 200
